detail.title: Ceramic tile vacuum adsorption piece and ceramic tile are sticked device
detail.abstract: The utility model discloses a kind of ceramic tile vacuum adsorption piece, for coordinating supporting block and vacuum pump to use with the ceramic tile that is sticked, the vacuum suction part is plate-like and is divided into an at least vacuum cup, the vacuum suction part includes opposite first surface and second surface, the first surface is sticked in the supporting block and corresponding at least one vacuum cup offers air channel, adsorption tank formed with least one vacuum cup on the second surface is corresponding ceramic tile is adsorbed on the second surface, the vacuum cup is equipped with the aspirating hole for connecting the air channel and the adsorption tank.In addition, being sticked device the invention also discloses a kind of ceramic tile, for coordinating vacuum pump to use, include supporting block and at least one ceramic tile vacuum adsorption piece as described above, the air channel of one of them described vacuum suction part of the suction port connection of the vacuum pump.
